primary_rows_used: centred three-month ONI windows with centre months January 1981 through December 2014
persistence_rule: at least five consecutive overlapping three-month seasons
known_page_inconsistency: The frozen page heading/method identify ERSSTv6, while one warning paragraph retains the text ERSSTv5; the archived ERSSTv6 table and URL are the pinned analytical source.
operational_index_note: NOAA CPC operational monitoring changed to RONI in 2026; this historical study remains frozen to ONI and does not mix index definitions.
